current_bridge.reason: The documented in-place recovery ladder is blocked before setup/install because the JuNest binary itself is absent or the wrapper state is nonstandard.

headline_findings: Current Rust availability basis is `unavailable` with blocking codes `junest-binary-missing`, `native-cargo-missing`, `native-rustc-missing`; the environment therefore classifies as `junest_binary_missing`.

There is a real distinction between “recoverable here” and “blocked before recovery starts”: JuNest-home-missing and JuNest-toolchain-missing are salvageable inside this cloudtainer, but JuNest-binary-missing is not.

When recovery is impossible here, the best blocked-session fallback remains `make cloudtainer-shadow-pass-medium`; it refreshes the comeback queue and seed-loader inputs in about `38.141` buffered seconds.

The first real Rust foothold on a capable machine is still `quick_foothold`: apply `artifacts/patches/rust_external_test_shards/01_fsm_grim_trigger_probe.patch` and run `cargo test -p gr_engine --test probe_run lift_fsm_strategy_family_lift_first_seed -- --exact` before broadening to `cargo test -p gr_engine --test probe_run`.
Full comeback closure still ends at shard prefix `10` over targets `metamorphic_suite`, `probe_run`; there is no earlier pure probe-only closure plateau.
